items.title: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
items.synopsis: In never-before-heard prison calls recorded before his death, convicted killer Charles Manson reveals the twisted motivations for his gruesome crimes.

items.title: Nando Between Two Worlds
items.synopsis: A Sintonia Film (2026) Netflix Original — Fans of the beloved Brazilian teen crime drama Sintonia won’t want to miss this highly anticipated Portuguese-language spin-off movie. It centers entirely on fan-favorite Nando as he navigates his dangerous dual life, delivering plenty of signature action and high stakes.

items.title: Mourinho
items.synopsis: Iconic game footage, sideline antics, interviews with top footballers and tales from the man himself tell the story of José Mourinho's firecracker career.

items.title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
items.synopsis: Stand-up comedy special.

items.title: Dr. Seuss's Red Fish, Blue Fish (Season 3)
items.synopsis: Building a snowman under the sea? Meeting a shark and serving him tea? Red and Blue's days are full of surprises, with ocean pals of all shapes and sizes!

items.title: The Ribbon Hero
items.synopsis: An adaptation of Osamu Tezuka's manga series Princess Knight, it is produced by Netflix and Twin Engine and animated by Outline.  It features character designs by Kei Mochizuki, with Mai Yoneyama and Issei Arakaki contributing to the designs, and Satoru Kosaki and Ryuichi Takada composing the music.

items.title: Our Sticky Love (Season 1)
items.synopsis: When a dangerous run-in with a powerful crime syndicate leaves fierce prosecutor Go Eun-sae with severe amnesia, she unexpectedly crosses paths with Jang Tae-ha, a former boxing prodigy turned gang member. Recognizing Eun-sae as his childhood first love, Tae-ha decides the only way to protect her from the mob is to falsely claim he is her boyfriend and whisk her away into hiding. Directed by Kim Jang-han, this South Korean romantic comedy series stars Jung Hae-in, Ha Young, Heo Sung-tae, and Lee Jae-won.

items.title: Ricky Gervais Alley Cats
items.synopsis: Curl up with a clutter of useless cats as they swear at the telly, debate life's most outrageous questions and cause chaos in the local community.

items.title: Operation Safed Sagar: The Untold Story of the Kargil War
items.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of the 1999 Kargil War, this military drama series follows the Indian Air Force’s Golden Arrows Squadron as they launch a high-stakes aerial campaign against entrenched enemy forces. The show explores the immense courage, personal sacrifices, and impossible choices faced by the fighter pilots and their families as they overcome unprecedented high-altitude terrain and operational challenges to protect their country’s borders. Created by Kushal Srivastava and directed by Oni Sen.

items.title: Death Inc. (Season 4)
items.synopsis: Final season of the rescued Spanish comedy drama.

items.title: The Last House
items.synopsis: Formerly developed under the working title 11817, this genre-bending sci-fi horror blockbuster is directed by action veteran Louis Leterrier. Starring Greta Lee and Wagner Moura, the 1-hour and 50-minute survival thriller is poised to be one of Netflix’s biggest late-summer cinematic events.

items.title: My Life With the Walter Boys (Season 3)
items.synopsis: In the coming of age show, following the loss of her family in a tragic accident, 16-year old Manhattanite Jackie Howard has to learn to adapt to a new life in rural Colorado with her guardian – and 12 very rowdy kids.

items.title: Cien años de soledad (Season 2)
items.synopsis: The story of the Buendia family, who lived for a century in the town of Macondo. It will be the first time that Gabriel García Márquez's seminal novel One Hundred Years of Solitude is adapted for the screen, more than 50 years after it was originally published, in 1967.

items.title: 1670 (Season 3)
items.synopsis: In this satirical comedy, a zany nobleman navigates through family feuds and clashes with peasants in his quest to become Poland's most famous figure.

items.title: Let's Marry Harry
items.synopsis: Harry Jowsey is done playing the field. Now, his inner circle is stepping in to help steer his love life, weighing in on every date, every match, and every tough call as he navigates a handpicked pool of potential partners. Is Harry finally ready to find a wife and settle down for good?

items.title: Big Chicken: A Fast Food Conspiracy
items.synopsis: Stand aside, Super Size Me . Comedian Mo Gilligan is here to try a new 28-day experiment where he eats absolutely nothing but fried chicken.

items.title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
items.synopsis: This gripping Swedish documentary special offers a fascinating deep dive into the shocking events and aftermath of one of the country’s most infamous corporate financial crimes.

items.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude (Part 2)
items.synopsis: Following the massive launch of Part 1, the sweeping Spanish-language adaptation of Gabriel García Márquez’s masterpiece returns. This grand finale beautifully wraps up the generations-spanning magical realism saga of the Buendía family in the mythic town of Macondo.

items.title: Ravu Jôtô (Season 2)
items.synopsis: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.

items.title: Badly in Love (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Japanese reality dating show.

items.title: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
items.synopsis: This six-part factual drama chronicles the devastating aftermath and the sprawling international investigation into the 1988 terrorist bombing of Pan Am Flight 103 over Lockerbie, Scotland. Highlighting the collaboration between Scottish and U.S. law enforcement, the series stars Connor Swindells, Merritt Wever, and Patrick J. Adams.

items.title: Fúria
items.synopsis: Fúria tells the story of a young man rescued from the brink of death by an MMA coach. With no memory of his own identity, he is given the name Marcelo and finds a new purpose in the world of MMA. But as he is drawn deeper into this universe, he begins to uncover clues to his past and becomes entangled in a web of crime, secrets and rivalries that reaches far beyond the cage.

items.title: Proyecto Final
items.synopsis: New school, new start — until vicious online attacks and a classmate's twisted challenge spark a dangerous bond that pushes Tamara toward transformation.

items.title: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
items.synopsis: From the crime scene to the courtroom, this true-crime series unpacks the University of Idaho murders and the hunt for Bryan Kohberger in forensic detail.

items.title: Final Project (Season 1)
items.synopsis: Mexican teen drama.

items.title: Forbidden Woman (Season 1)
items.synopsis: Colombian series adaptation. When a politician’s wife is rescued from attempted murder by a famous singer, sparks fly in this tale of forbidden love, corruption and power.

items.title: Wrath (Season 1)
items.synopsis: Brazilian crime drama series. Starring Vinicius Neri, Fábio Lago, and Alice Carvalho. A wounded amnesiac finds refuge with an MMA coach and steps into the ring, torn between hope for a new future and a dangerous past that keeps closing in.

items.title: Better Late Than Single (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Ready to step into the dating world, lifelong singles get expert help for style, health and confidence. Will they manage hiccups on their way to love?

items.title: Bloody Smart
items.synopsis: In a town where strict rules shape students into their "best selves," a hidden Bloodfruit Tree bears crimson fruit. A mysterious boy in black delivers these fruits only to those who truly "need" them. Once received, they awaken long-suppressed desires—gently unravelling the heart, and quietly leading the town toward irreversible collapse.

items.title: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain
items.synopsis: Stand-up special.

items.title: WWE Monday Night RAW (Season 33)
items.synopsis: WWE Monday Night RAW is World Wrestling Entertainment's (formerly the WWF and the WWWF before that) premiere wrestling event and brand. Since its launch in 1993, WWE Monday Night RAW continues to air live on Monday nights. It is generally seen as the company's flagship program due to its prolific history, high ratings, weekly live format, and emphasis on pay-per-views. Monday Night RAW is high profile enough to attract frequent visits from celebrities who usually serve as guest hosts for a single live event. Since its first episode, the show has been broadcast live or recorded from more than 197 different arenas in 165 cities and towns in seven different nations: including the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom twice a year, Afghanistan for a special Tribute to the Troops, Germany, Japan, Italy and Mexico.

items.title: Instadocs: The Prediction Games
items.synopsis: 36 min film.

items.title: Heartstopper (Season 3)
items.synopsis: Heartstopper tells the story of Nick and Charlie, two British teens at an all-boys grammar school. Charlie, a highly-strung, openly gay over-thinker, and Nick, a cheerful, soft-hearted rugby player, who one day are made to sit together.

items.title: The Adam Ray Show
items.synopsis: Same host. Different characters. All chaos. Each week, Adam Ray taps into his roster of alter egos to interview famous guests — and no one is safe.

items.title: Musafir Cafe
items.synopsis: Chander feels an undeniable connection with Sudha. Years later, he builds a new life in the hills with Preeti, but memories of the past linger.

items.title: 72 Hours
items.synopsis: Hoping to save his flailing career, a forty-year-old executive inadvertently joins a group of twenty-somethings on a wild three-day bachelor party after being added to their group text by mistake. Directed by Tim Story, this comedy stars Kevin Hart, Marcello Hernández, Mason Gooding, Kam Patterson, Ben Marshall, and Teyana Taylor.

items.title: The Truthers
items.synopsis: Returning home after her mother’s mysterious death, an estranged daughter reunites with her erratic, conspiracy-obsessed father, only to suspect that he might be the murderer. Directed by Roger Gual and written by Carlos Montero and Darío Madrona, this tense Spanish drama stars Stéphanie Magnin, Jose Coronado, Fanny Gautier, and Alberto Olmo.

items.title: Ransom Canyon (Season 2)
items.synopsis: Ransom Canyon is a romance-fueled family drama and contemporary western saga that charts the intersecting lives of three ranching families, all set against the rugged expanse of Texas Hill Country.

items.title: Kaulitz & Kaulitz (Season 3)
items.synopsis: Bill and Tom Kaulitz bring us close to their life as Tokio Hotel frontmen, podcast hosts and close-knit twins, and to the highs and lows of fame.

items.title: Love in Slow Motion
items.synopsis: Kuwaiti romantic comedy.

items.title: The Debt Collector
items.synopsis: Thai thriller. Tormented by past mistakes and a terminal diagnosis, an ex-debt collector returns to the underworld to protect the victims of a violent organization.

items.title: The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On (Season 4)
items.synopsis: Get hitched or call it quits? Couples put their love to the test — while shacking up with other potential matches — in a provocative reality series.

items.title: The Love Lab
items.synopsis: An innovative dating experiment reality show that breaks away from the conventions of traditional dating programs. Unfamiliar men and women are placed in extreme and controlled environments, facing unexpected experiments such as blind dates in bed and romances in isolation. Through unpredictable situations, the show dynamically captures the participants' raw, instinctive emotions and the realistic changes in their relationships.

items.title: Lock Upp (Season 2)
items.synopsis:
The series follows contestants, known as inmates, who live in a jail-themed setting and compete in tasks while facing eliminations. 
The first season, titled Lock Upp: Badass Jail, Atyaachari Khel!

items.title: GIGN
items.synopsis: After an unprecedented attack on his elite unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

items.title: El otro padre
items.synopsis: With her daughter's life on the line, a doctor's search for a kidney donor exposes a secret affair and a DNA test that could shatter two families.

items.title: A Toxic Love Story
items.synopsis: Documentary. In a glamorous California suburb, a young woman’s arrest for a violent fantasy plot becomes a sensational scandal, but the truth remains hidden behind a sophisticated web of deception. As the investigation peels back layers of betrayal, it becomes unclear who is the true victim and who is the villain in a game where everyone is playing a part.

items.title: Elite Force (Season 1)
items.synopsis: Previously known as GIGN, this new French crime thriller finally drops on Netflix.

items.title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
items.synopsis: Based on the 2012 Murder of Marcos Matsunaga, it dramatizes the events leading up to the crime through a fictionalized account of Elize Matsunaga's life and marriage.

items.title: My Daughter's Father
items.synopsis: Drama series.
